mpn: MSP3520 3.5in 320x480 SPI TFT module with touch (ILI9488)
description: 3.5" 320 x 480 colour TFT module (ILI9488) with resistive touch (XPT2046), SPI, on a 1x14 female header: VCC GND CS RESET DC SDI SCK LED SDO T_CLK T_CS T_DIN T_DO T_IRQ; courtyard the 56.34 x 98 mm module lying over the board

datasheet.revision: lcdwiki 3.5inch SPI Module ILI9488 SKU:MSP3520: interface definition (14 pins), product parameters (module PCB 56.34 x 98 mm, VCC 3.3-5 V, 3.3 V logic)

package.name: 3.5" SPI TFT module, 1 x 14 socket
package.page: lcdwiki MSP3520: pins 1 VCC, 2 GND, 3 CS, 4 RESET, 5 DC/RS, 6 SDI(MOSI), 7 SCK, 8 LED, 9 SDO(MISO), 10 T_CLK, 11 T_CS, 12 T_DIN, 13 T_DO, 14 T_IRQ; module PCB 56.34 x 98 mm. The header position is assumed as on the MSP2807 (a centred row 2 mm from the bottom short edge): not read from MSP3520_Size.pdf

footprint: moduleSocket("TFT_3.5in_ILI9488_Socket_1x14_P2.54mm", socketRow(1, 14, (-16.51mm, 0mm), (2.54mm, 0mm)), box((-28.17mm, -2.0mm), (28.17mm, 96.0mm)), description = "3.5 inch ILI9488 TFT module with touch on a 1x14 female header along its bottom edge, the display facing up over +Y: VCC, GND, CS, RESET, DC, SDI, SCK, LED, SDO, T_CLK, T_CS, T_DIN, T_DO, T_IRQ left to right", parts = 5.8mm, color = "#b02020", module = displayPanel(box((-27.75mm, 4.5mm), (27.75mm, 89.46mm)), box((-24.48mm, 12.61mm), (24.48mm, 86.05mm)), 3.7mm, glass = 1.2mm, tape = 0.5mm))

pins.name: LED
pins.description: backlight on when high (tie to 3.3 V if not dimmed)

pins.name: SDO
pins.description: LCD SPI data out (MISO); may stay open

pins.name: T_CS
pins.description: touch controller chip select, active low

notes: Logic 3.3 V TTL even with VCC at 5 V.
The ILI9488 SPI interface takes 18-bit colour (3 bytes a pixel): 320 x 480 x 24 bits at 60 MHz SPI is about 16 frames per second full screen; a 320 x 200 game area letterboxed is about 39.
The LCD and the touch controller share one SPI bus with separate CS and T_CS; keep T_CS high when unused.
LED high lights the backlight (module resistor); PWM it from a GPIO.
Check the header position against the vendor drawing MSP3520_Size.pdf before ordering: here it is assumed as on the 2.8" MSP2807.
